title: Breakfast link, pattie, or slice, meatless

content.title: About
content.content: Breakfast link, pattie, or slice, meatless (2233) is a vegetarian alternative to traditional breakfast meat products. Made from plant proteins, whole grains and spices, it provides a tasty and satisfying breakfast without meat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Suitable for vegetarians and those reducing meat consumption.
Contains plant proteins such as soy and pea protein.
Flavor is designed to mimic classic breakfast sausage products.
Packaged in convenient single‑serve portions for quick preparation.
May be gluten‑free when formulated accordingly, making it suitable for gluten‑free diets.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Provides a substantial amount of protein needed for muscle maintenance and satiety.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with traditional meat counterparts, it contains less saturated fat, supporting heart health.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Whole grains and legumes contribute to digestive health and stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Fortified with vitamin B12 and other B‑vitamins important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Cholesterol‑free
items.content: Completely free of cholesterol, making it a safe choice for those monitoring cholesterol intake.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Contains soy protein, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt is used for flavor; people watching sodium intake should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Some versions may contain gluten; check the label if you have celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Food additives
items.content: May include preservatives and flavor enhancers; consider individual tolerances.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat quickly in a skillet, microwave, or oven. Serve with toast, vegetables, eggs, or as a sandwich filling. It can also be sliced and added to salads for extra protein.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in the original packaging or an airtight container. After opening, use within 5–7 days. Discard if it develops off‑odors or discoloration.
